rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for goods, food, or money kept in reserve for future use.

example.english: We keep a provision of drinking water at home, so we do not have to hunt around during typhoons.
example.traditional: 我哋屋企平時都有食水儲備，打風嗰陣就唔使周圍撲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 ping4 si4 dou1 jau5 sik6 seoi2 cyu5 bei6 daa2 fung1 go2 zan6 zau6 m4 sai2 zau1 wai4 puk1

rows.note: Use this for preparation made beforehand, rather than for the supplies or money themselves.

example.english: We made provision for the event well in advance, so we would not be flustered on the day.
example.traditional: 我哋一早就為個活動做好準備，臨場唔會手忙腳亂。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 zou2 zau6 wai6 go3 wut6 dung6 zou6 hou2 zeon2 bei6 lam4 coeng4 m4 wui5 sau2 mong4 goek3 lyun6

rows.note: Use this for the supplying or making available aspect of provision, especially in phrases about a service or resource.

example.english: This scheme will continue the provision of free lunch boxes until the end of the year.
example.traditional: 呢個計劃會繼續供應免費飯盒到年底。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 gai3 waak6 wui5 gai3 zuk6 gung1 jing3 min5 fai3 faan6 hap2 dou3 nin4 dai2
